# Dev Chauhan

> Designer and developer building open-source tools for the web.

Dev Chauhan is a designer and developer based in India studying Computer Science and Engineering (B.Tech). He builds high-performance web applications, icon systems, and developer tools using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Supabase.

Last updated: 2026-10-22

## Projects

### Reicon

Open-source visual asset library with 3,900+ UI SVG icons across 3 styles, 4,900+ brand logos, and 71,000+ vector illustrations. Available for React, Vue, Svelte, and Flutter, with an MCP server for AI coding agents. MIT licensed, tree-shakeable, and zero dependencies.

- [Website](https://reicon.dev)
- [Repository](https://github.com/dqev/reicon)

### TopFree

Free and fair product launch board for indie makers. Ranked entirely by real community votes, with zero paid boosts and no cost to submit.

- [Website](https://topfree.lol)

### Curto Serif

Free, open-source variable serif for editorial headlines and brand identities. Weights 400–700, true italics, 376 glyphs, 86-language support, and licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

- [Website](https://devchauhan.in/curto)
- [Download 1.001](https://devchauhan.in/curto/CurtoSerif-1.001.zip)
- [Repository](https://github.com/dqev/curto)

## Writing

The `/writing` index is retired. Articles are published at individual URLs.

### [Curto Serif: The Free Open-Source Serif for 2026](https://devchauhan.in/writing/curto)

Why Curto Serif is a strong free serif choice for 2026, what makes a display serif work, and how a specimen-first page can earn more search impressions. Published 2026-10-20.

### [Will society accept me as a designer (vibe-coded) if I don't have a vibe-coded component library?](https://devchauhan.in/writing/vibe-coded-designers)

A personal reflection on vibe-coded component libraries, X timeline culture, design authorship, and what defines a designer in the AI era. Published 2026-09-15.

### [Building Reicon - 2,700+ UI Icons](https://devchauhan.in/writing/reicon)

How Reicon was built: handcrafted UI icons on a strict 24×24 grid, distributed across seven framework packages, with native MCP support for AI agents. Published 2026-07-29.
